item.title: Minneapolis council passes ordinance to extend pre-eviction notices to 60 days
item.description: The Minneapolis City Council passed the "Pause Evictions, Save Lives Ordinance" aimed at protecting renters whose lives were disrupted by Operation Metro Surge.
